rating_definitions.substantial: Independent corroboration and primary or specialist page-level evidence with precise place-based interpretation and visitor/rights confirmation
rating_definitions.developing: Specific evidence and source locator supporting explanatory treatment but primary, triangulation or field validation remains open
rating_definitions.sparse: Abstract/secondary-only or approximate geographical evidence; cannot support complete explanation
rating_definitions.missing: Missing core object, georeferenced field evidence, or reproduction permissions
